ActionApprovalCapability.description: One exact capability included in an action approval request.

ActionApprovalCapabilityKind.description: Capability kind displayed and approved through a durable Agent interaction.

ActionApprovalDecision.description: User decision for one exact action approval interaction.

ActionApprovalRequest.description:
Durable request for approval of one policy-bound action.

`sandbox_denial` is present only for one exact retry after a safe sandbox denial.

ActionApprovalResponse.description: Durable response to an action approval request.

ApprovalReviewModelSelectionDto.description: User-facing selection for the model that reviews approval requests.

CommandId.description: Stable caller-supplied identity for one retry-safe product command.

ConfigChanged.description: Notification payload emitted after a durable Config authority commit.

ConfigCommandResult.description: Compact result of a retry-safe configuration mutation.

ConfigReadResult.description: Current user configuration snapshot returned by `config/read`.

ConfigUpdateParams.description: Patch for user preferences at one expected Config revision.

DiffComputeParams.description: Inputs for one presentation-independent comparison of two text snapshots.

DiffComputeResult.description: Canonical Rust diff data projected for a frontend line model.

DiffComputeRowDto.description: One aligned diff row in the frontend's zero-based line coordinate system.

DiffHunkDto.description: One bounded hunk range in the returned row projection.

DiffRangeDto.description: One changed inline region expressed in Alpha's zero-based UTF-16 columns.

DiffRowKindDto.description: The semantic kind of one aligned original/modified row.

FsChanged.description: Coarse workspace filesystem invalidation published by `fs/changed`.

oneOf.description: The backend observed changes near these sorted workspace-relative paths.
The watcher may have lost events and consumers must rescan their visible scope.

FsFileType.description: Stable filesystem entry kind exposed to clients.

FsGetMetadataParams.description: Read metadata for one path relative to the configured workspace root.

FsGetMetadataResult.description: Metadata returned for one existing workspace path.

FsReadDirectoryParams.description: List direct children for one directory relative to the configured workspace root.

FsReadFileParams.description: Read one UTF-8 file relative to the configured workspace root.

FsWriteFileParams.description: Atomically write one UTF-8 file relative to the configured workspace root.

GitBranchDto.description: One local branch returned by the workspace Git runtime.

GitCommitSummaryDto.description: One commit in the bounded history projection used by repository graph views.

GitHistoryResult.description: Bounded recent commit history for the active workspace repository.

GitTextDiffDto.description: One bounded UTF-8 text change from `HEAD` to the workspace working tree.

GitTextDiffResult.description: One authoritative status snapshot plus its bounded workspace text-diff projection.

HookActionDto.description: Runtime-free Hook action. Execution still requires policy and sandbox approval.

HookConfigDto.description: Declarative Hook configuration exposed through the App Server contract.

HookEnablementDto.description: Desired enablement of one Hook declaration.

HookEventDto.description: Safe-point event that may request a Hook execution.

HookMatcherDto.description: Optional exact tool-name matcher for tool-related Hook events.

HookSetEnablementParams.description: Changes desired enablement for one configured user Hook.

HookUpsertParams.description: Creates or replaces one declarative user Hook.

InteractionCancelReason.description:
Why a previously outstanding interaction was closed without a response.

The reason is durable so recovery and clients can distinguish an explicit Turn interruption
from a deadline or delivery failure. The policy deciding which reason applies lives outside
this shared contract.

InteractionDeadline.description:
A wall-clock deadline that the interaction owner must enforce.

`expires_at_unix_ms` is persisted as an absolute instant so recovery can determine whether a
request is still actionable after a process restart. The protocol does not prescribe the
timeout policy or clock implementation.

ItemId.description: Stable identity for one durable transcript item within a Turn.

JsonRpcId.description:
A JSON-RPC request identifier.

JSON-RPC permits string and number identifiers; `Null` is retained for parse and invalid
request error responses. The App Server dispatcher applies its narrower positive-integer
request-ID policy after decoding this wire representation.

JsonRpcNotification.description: A JSON-RPC notification envelope, which intentionally has no request identifier.

JsonRpcRequest.description:
A JSON-RPC request envelope.

`params` is generic so callers can bind it to a concrete protocol DTO. The App Server applies
its own request-ID policy at its dispatch boundary.

JsonRpcResponse.description: A JSON-RPC response, which contains exactly one success result or error object.

JsonRpcVersion.description: The only JSON-RPC version accepted by the current wire encoding.

LanguageServerConfigDto.description: Runtime-free language-server preference exposed through the App Server contract.

LanguageServerConfigureParams.description: Creates or replaces one user-owned language-server preference.

LanguageServerModeDto.description: Durable user intent for one language server.

LanguageServerRemoveParams.description: Removes an explicit language-server preference and restores the product default.

McpCredentialBindingDto.description: Non-secret credential binding for a standalone MCP server declaration.

McpServerConfigDto.description: Desired, runtime-free standalone MCP server configuration.

McpServerEnablementDto.description: Desired enablement for a configured MCP server.

McpServerRemoveParams.description: Removes one standalone MCP server declaration.

McpServerSetEnablementParams.description: Changes desired enablement for one configured standalone MCP server.

McpServerUpsertParams.description: Creates or replaces one standalone MCP server declaration.

McpTransportDto.description: Non-secret transport declaration for a standalone MCP server.

PendingInteraction.description:
Redaction-safe metadata for a Turn that is waiting on an interaction.

The full request payload stays in the durable interaction fact so an App Server can redeliver
it to its selected owner after recovery. Readable Thread snapshots expose only this metadata,
preventing a broad subscription from becoming an implicit interaction-delivery channel.

PluginRequestDto.description: Declarative request for one exact Plugin package.

PluginRequestEnablementDto.description: Desired participation of one exact Plugin request in future activation resolution.

PluginRequestSetEnablementParams.description: Changes desired enablement for one configured Plugin request.

PluginRequestUpsertParams.description: Creates or replaces one exact user Plugin request.

ProcessExecutionOutput.description: Provider-independent process result retained across executor and Core boundaries.

ProcessExitStatus.description: How a sandboxed process terminated before its captured output was returned.

ProviderConfigDto.description: Non-secret declarative provider settings exposed through the App Server contract.

ProviderConfigureParams.description: Creates or replaces one provider entry in the user configuration authority.

ProviderRemoveParams.description: Removes one provider entry from the user configuration authority.

RequestId.description: Stable identity for one outstanding bidirectional Agent interaction.

SandboxDenialOutput.description:
Trustworthy result of an execution attempt rejected by sandbox enforcement.

Producers must not use this for an ordinary non-zero exit. Captured streams must already be
bounded and secret-free before this value crosses the executor boundary.

Session.description:
Canonical product-level container for a task and its Thread topology.

A Session owns Thread membership and lineage, but not the child Threads' Turn or Item history.
Each Thread remains an independent ordering, persistence, and execution boundary.

SessionEvent.description: A durable structural fact in one product Session's event stream.

SessionId.description: Stable identity for one product-level Agent session.

SessionRequest.description:
A typed mutation submitted against one Session aggregate.

Child Thread identifiers are selectors inside the Session boundary. Product hosts submit
these operations through `session/request`; App Server owns the internal Thread routing.

SessionRequestParams.description: The canonical Session aggregate mutation request.

SessionRequestResult.description: Typed result returned by the canonical Session aggregate mutation endpoint.

SessionSubscribeResult.description: The aggregate Session port returned to product hosts.

SessionThread.description: A Session-owned reference to one Thread, its origin, and membership lifecycle.

SessionThreadProjection.description: A child Thread snapshot and its committed gap carried by the Session subscription.

SessionThreadStatus.description: Session-owned lifecycle for one Thread membership.

SkillId.description: Source-qualified stable identity for one Skill.

SkillName.description: Agent Skills-compatible name, unique within one Skill source.

SkillSourceAddParams.description: Adds a user-owned, runtime-free Skill source declaration.

SkillSourceConfigDto.description: Runtime-free declaration for one user-owned Skill source.

SkillSourceEnablementDto.description: Desired enablement for one configured user Skill source.

SkillSourceId.description: Stable identity for one configured, built-in, Workspace, or Plugin Skill source.

SkillSourceRemoveParams.description: Removes one user-owned Skill source declaration.

SkillSourceSetEnablementParams.description: Changes desired enablement for one configured user Skill source.

SlashCommandArgumentModeDto.description: Whether a server-advertised slash command accepts inline composer arguments.

SlashCommandDefinition.description:
One server-advertised command in the immutable initialization snapshot.

Clients may merge these commands with local presentation commands. A submitted dynamic command
remains ordinary ordered Turn input; the definition only makes its slash syntax discoverable
and declares whether inline arguments are accepted.

StreamCursor.description: Ephemeral ordering cursor for updates that are not part of durable aggregate history.

StreamInstanceId.description:
Stable identity for one transient stream-emitter incarnation.

A new value is created whenever the emitter restarts. Its sequence is meaningful only within
that instance, so consumers must discard a previous cursor when this value changes.

TerminalCloseParams.description: Terminates and releases one connection-owned terminal.

TerminalCommandStatus.description: Renderer-independent lifecycle state for one shell command.

TerminalCommandStatusEvent.description: One ordered command lifecycle transition associated with PTY output.

TerminalCreateParams.description: Starts one connection-owned interactive terminal at the server's trusted workspace root.

TerminalCreateResult.description: Identity allocated for one interactive terminal.

TerminalOutputChunk.description: One ordered raw PTY output chunk encoded for JSON transport.

TerminalProfile.description: One server-owned shell profile available to interactive terminal clients.

TerminalProfileListResult.description: Trusted terminal profiles discovered by the local App Server composition.

TerminalProfileSelection.description: Selects either the server default or one previously listed trusted profile.

TerminalReadParams.description: Reads output after the last sequence observed by this client.

TerminalReadResult.description: Bounded output and process state for one interactive terminal.

TerminalWriteParams.description: Writes one bounded UTF-8 input batch to an interactive terminal.

Thread.description: Canonical readable state for one independently ordered Agent execution branch.

ThreadEvent.description:
A durable fact in one Thread's authoritative event stream.

This enum deliberately excludes token deltas, delivery notifications, and client requests so
persistence adapters cannot accidentally append transient runtime messages.

ThreadId.description: Stable identity for one independently ordered Agent execution branch.

ThreadItem.description: A normalized, provider-independent item produced or consumed during one Thread turn.

ThreadOrigin.description: How a Thread entered a product Session.

ThreadUpdate.description:
Consumer-facing update for one Thread.

`Committed` carries a durable fact. The remaining variants are low-latency projections and
may be dropped; a later committed Item snapshot remains authoritative.

ToolCallId.description: Stable identity for one model-requested tool call and its eventual result.

ToolExecutionAuthority.description: Durable authority selected before a Tool Call crosses its side-effect boundary.

ToolName.description: Validated provider-independent name used to register and invoke a tool.

ToolReplaySafety.description: Whether Core may automatically execute the same exact Tool Call after sandbox review.

Turn.description: Canonical readable state for one user-intent-driven Agent execution.

TurnId.description: Stable identity for one user-intent-driven Agent execution within a Thread.

TurnInteraction.description:
One outstanding interaction that pauses a Turn until it is resolved or cancelled.

The request is durable product state. Selecting a connection that receives it is an App
Server delivery concern and deliberately does not appear here.

WorkspaceSearchCancelParams.description: Cancels and releases one connection-owned workspace search.

WorkspaceSearchCaseSensitivity.description: Selects the case-matching behavior used by one workspace search.

WorkspaceSearchMatch.description: One line containing one or more matches in a workspace-relative file.

WorkspaceSearchMatchRange.description: UTF-16 range within one returned preview line.

WorkspaceSearchPatternKind.description: Selects how the workspace search query is interpreted by the backend.

WorkspaceSearchReadParams.description: Reads a bounded result batch after an already observed match cursor.

WorkspaceSearchReadResult.description: Bounded progress snapshot for a running or completed workspace search.

WorkspaceSearchStartParams.description: Starts one bounded, connection-owned workspace content search.

WorkspaceSearchStartResult.description: Identity allocated for one running workspace search.

WorkspaceSwitchParams.description: Replaces the trusted local Workspace hosted by one App Server.

WorkspaceSwitchResult.description: Confirms the canonical Workspace root accepted by the App Server.
